paragraphs: Tronox is the world's leading vertically integrated manufacturer of TiO2 pigment. We operate titanium-bearing mineral sand mines and beneficiation and smelting operations in Australia and South Africa to produce feedstock materials that can be processed into TiO2 for pigment, high purity titanium chemicals, including titanium tetrachloride, and ultrafine TiO2 used in certain specialty applications. Our strategy is to be vertically integrated and produce enough feedstock materials to be as self-sufficient as possible in the production of TiO2 at our seven pigment facilities located in the United States, Australia, Brazil, UK, France, and the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. We believe that vertical integration is the best way to achieve our ultimate goal of delivering low cost, high-quality pigment to our approximately 1,200 TiO2 customers throughout the world. The mining, beneficiation and smelting of titanium bearing mineral sands also creates meaningful quantities of co-products including zircon, pig iron and the rare-earth bearing mineral, monazite, which we also supply to customers around the world.

The following sets forth the key strategic initiatives underway in 2025:

Our ability to compete effectively in the TiO2 industry is determined by many factors, including innovation, reliability, product quality, customer service and price. The business processes that allow us to maximize the benefit of our vertical integration and global footprint --- the so-called "hidden factory" --- needs to be optimized if we are to successfully meet the pricing and other competitive pressures that characterize our industry. Throughout 2025, the Company reinforced its commitment to sustaining and enhancing its vertical integration competitive advantage. Key milestones were the successful commissioning of the Fairbreeze extension and the completion of construction at Namakwa East OFS which is currently in the process of being commissioned - two major mining projects in South Africa which replace existing mines approaching end of life. These new sites are expected to provide abundant reserves of natural rutile and zircon, along with high-grade ilmenite suitable for direct use or slag processing, ensuring a secure and cost-effective feedstock supply for years to come. These strategic investments are projected to deliver returns above the Company's cost of capital.

In 2025, we launched a comprehensive Sustainable Cost Improvement Program designed to enhance cost efficiency and optimize asset performance across all aspects of our business. This initiative delivered over $90 million in annualized savings by year-end 2025 and is projected to achieve approximately $125-$175 million in annualized savings (including the $90 million realized in 2025) by the end of 2026. The program focuses on four key pillars: Operational Excellence, Technology Enablement, Supply Chain Optimization, and Selling, General & Administrative Expenses Alignment. We believe this strategic approach will position us to sustain long-term value creation while maintaining operational resilience.

We took proactive measures to bolster liquidity and preserve flexibility, which included the successful execution of a $400 million senior secured bond offering which closed in September 2025, and reducing the quarterly dividend by 60%, effective in the third quarter of 2025. At the same time, throughout 2025, we implemented targeted operational measures to manage near-term cash flow, including: shutting down the Botlek pigment plant in the Netherlands, idling the Fuzhou pigment plant in China, and temporarily idling one furnace at the Namakwa smelter.

Tronox's existing mining operations and tailing piles in South Africa and Australia contain significant quantities of monazite, a mineral containing rare earth elements (REEs) widely recognized as a critical mineral for the energy transformation underway to decarbonize the world's economy. For these applications, REE must first be processed into an oxide form --- rare earth oxides or "REO" --- that can then be metallized for the production of permanent magnets. Every step of the REE supply chain today is dominated by China. China's dominance of the processing of REO and production of permanent magnets is widely recognized as a serious strategic challenge by democratic governments around the world.

The separation, beneficiation and processing technologies that Tronox uses to turn titanium-bearing ores into TiO2 are applicable for turning monazite into REO. In the past, we sold our monazite in unconcentrated form as a waste product but given the increased value associated with REE, we are now seeking to maximize the value of our existing geologic resources and deploy our substantial technical know how and human capital to become a significant supplier of REO to non-Chinese producers of metals and permanent magnets.

In 2025, we received coordinated, non-binding and conditional letters of support/interest from Export Finance Australia and Export-Import Bank of the United States, respectively for up to an aggregate of US $600 million in limited or non-recourse financing to support the development of Tronox's rare earth supply chain. In addition, we took an approximate 5% equity interest in Lion Rock Minerals (ASX-LRM) ("LRM"), a mineral exploration company whose Minta and Minta Est deposits have the potential to be a major source of high quality monazite and rutile. Continuing to seek funding sources and develop a rare earth minerals business is an ongoing focus of management. See "Risk Factors - The Company may not be successful in arranging required financing and/or developing a financeable structure for its rare earth initiatives, and even if the required financing is obtained and/or a financing structure is achieved, the Company may not be successful in developing a viable rare earth supply chain."

TiO2 pigment is used in a wide range of products due to its ability to impart whiteness, brightness, and opacity. TiO2 pigment is used extensively in the manufacture of paint and other coatings, plastics and paper, and in a wide range of other applications. Moreover, it is a critical component of everyday consumer applications due to its superior ability to cover or mask other materials effectively and efficiently relative to alternative white pigments and extenders. TiO2 pigment is considered to be a quality of life product. At present, it is our belief that there is no effective substitute for TiO2 pigment because no other white pigment has the physical properties for achieving comparable opacity and brightness or can be incorporated as cost effectively.

We produce ultrafine TiO2 at our manufacturing facility in Thann, France. We market ultrafine TiO2 products under the CristalActiv® trademark. Ultrafine TiO2 has highly catalytic properties due to the relatively high surface area of each TiO2 molecule. The principal use of ultrafine TiO2 products is in NOx emission control products utilized in stationary, mobile and marine applications.

paragraphs: You should carefully consider the risk factors set forth below, as well as the other information contained in this Form 10-K, including our consolidated financial statements and related notes. This Form 10-K contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Any of the following risks could materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations. Additional risks and uncertainties not currently known to us or those we currently view to be immaterial may also materially and adversely affect our business, financial condition and results of operations. The following risk factors are not necessarily presented in order of relative importance and should not be considered to represent a complete set of all potential risks that could affect our business, financial condition and results of operations.

Market conditions, as well as global and regional economic downturns that adversely affect the demand for our end-use products, could adversely affect the results of our operations and the prices at which we can sell our products, thus, negatively impacting our financial results.

Our revenue and results of operations are significantly dependent on sales of TiO2 products and zircon. Demand for these products historically have been linked to global, regional and local GDP and discretionary spending, which can be negatively impacted by regional and world events or economic and market conditions. Such events can cause a decrease in demand for our products and market prices to fall, which may have an adverse effect on our results of operations and financial condition. A substantial portion of our products and raw materials are commodities that reprice as market supply and demand fundamentals change, and we have recently been experiencing a depressed trend in the commodity cycle for TiO2. Accordingly, product margins and the results of operations tend to vary with changes in the business cycle.

A significant portion of the demand for our TiO2 products comes from manufacturers of paint and plastics. A significant portion of the demand for zircon comes from the construction and other industrial end markets. Our customers may experience significant fluctuations in demand for their own end products because of economic conditions, changes in consumer demand, or increases in raw material and energy costs. In addition, with respect to the zircon market, we believe that China currently accounts for approximately 50% of the world's demand for zircon. However, there is currently a weakening demand in the domestic Chinese ceramics end-market as well as an increase in domestic Chinese zircon sand production, partially attributable to the Chinese continued focus on mining rare earth bearing minerals, which is adding to the global zircon supply. A prolonged economic downturn in China could result in reduced zircon and TiO2 demand in China as well as Chinese domestic zircon producers increasing exports of zircon at low prices which could have a material adverse effect on our business and financial results.

The price of our products, in particular, TiO2, zircon, and pig iron, have been, and in the future may be, volatile. Price declines for our products will negatively affect our financial position and results of operations.

paragraphs: Tronox 是全球領先的垂直整合製造 TiO2 零組件的公司。我們在澳洲與南非經營含鈦礦砂礦場與選礦與熔煉作業，以生產可進一步製成 TiO2 零組件、高純度鈦化學品，包括四氯化鈦，以及用於特定應用的超細 TiO2。我們的策略是垂直整合，並生產足夠的原料，以在美國、澳洲、巴西、英國、法國以及沙特王國的七座零組件工廠中盡可能實現自給自足。我們相信垂直整合是實現我們最終目標的最佳方式，即以低成本、高品質的零組件服務我們全球約 1,200 家 TiO2 客戶。含鈦礦砂的採礦、選礦與熔煉作業也會產生大量副產品，包括鋯石、生鐵以及含稀土礦物的單斜晶石，我們也將這些副產品供應給全球客戶。

以下顯示 2025 年進行的關鍵戰略行動：

我們在 TiO2 行業中有效競爭的能力，取決於許多因素，包括創新、可靠性、產品品質、客戶服務與價格。讓我們能最大化垂直整合與全球佈局效益的業務流程 --- 所謂的「隱藏工廠」--- 需要優化，以成功應對我們行業中價格及其他競爭壓力。在 2025 年期間，本公司強化了對維持與提升垂直整合競爭優勢的承諾。關鍵里程碑包括 Fairbreeze 延伸區的成功啟用，以及 Namakwa East OFS 建設的完成，目前正進行啟用程序，這是南非兩大採礦專案，用以取代即將達到使用年限的現有礦場。這些新礦區預期將提供豐富的天然金紅石與鋯石儲量，以及適合直接使用或渣處理的高品位鈦鐵礦，確保未來數年內穩定且成本效益良好的原料供應。這些戰略投資預期將產生超過本公司資本成本的回報。

在 2025 年，我們啟動了一項全面的永續成本改善計畫，旨在提升我們業務各方面的成本效益與資產表現。此計畫在 2025 年底已實現每年逾 90 百萬美元的節省，預計在 2026 年底將實現約 125 至 175 百萬美元的年度節省（包括 2025 年已實現的 90 百萬美元）。該計畫著重於四大支柱：運營卓越、科技啟動、供應鏈優化以及銷售、一般及行政費用對齊。我們相信此戰略方法將使我們能維持長期價值創造，同時保持運營韌性。
我們採取主動措施以強化流動性並維持靈活性，包括成功執行一筆 400 百萬美元的高級抵押債券發行，該發行於 2025 年 9 月完成，以及將季度股息減少 60%，自 2025 年第三季生效。同時，於 2025 年期間，我們實施了針對性的營運措施以管理近期現金流，包括：關閉荷蘭的 Botlek 色素廠、讓中國福州色素廠停工，以及暫時讓 Namakwa 熔爐之一停工。

Tronox 在南非及澳洲現有的礦業運作及尾礦堆中包含大量 monazite，一種含有稀土元素（REEs）的礦物，被廣泛認為是能源轉型以實現全球經濟去碳化的關鍵礦物。對於這些應用，REE 必須首先被處理成氧化形式 --- 稀土氧化物或 "REO" --- 之後才能進行冶金處理以製造永磁體。目前稀土元素供應鏈的每一個階段皆由中國主導。中國在處理 REO 及生產永磁體方面的主導地位，被全球民主國家廣泛認為是嚴重的戰略挑戰。
Tronox 用來將含鈦礦石轉化為 TiO2 的分離、選礦及處理技術，同樣適用於將 monazite 轉化為 REO。過去，我們將 monazite 以未濃縮形式銷售為廢料，但考慮到稀土元素的價值提高，我們現在致力於最大化我們現有地質資源的價值，並運用我們龐大的技術知識與人力資本，成為向非中國永磁體與金屬製造商提供 REO 的重要供應商。

2025 年，我們分別收到來自 Export Finance Australia 與 Export-Import Bank of the United States 的協調、非具約束力且附條件的支持/興趣函件，總計最多 600 百萬美元的有限或非追索權融資，以支持 Tronox 稀土供應鏈的發展。此外，我們取得約 5% 的 equity interest 在 Lion Rock Minerals (ASX-LRM) ("LRM")，一家礦物勘探公司的 Minta 及 Minta Est 儲備，有潛力成為高品質 monazite 及 rutile 的主要來源。持續尋找資金來源並發展稀土礦物業務，是管理層的持續重點。請參閱 "風險因素 - 本公司可能無法成功安排所需融資及/或發展可融資的結構以進行其稀土計畫，即使取得所需融資及/或達成融資結構，本公司可能仍無法成功發展可持續的稀土供應鏈。"
TiO2 色素因其能賦予產品白度、亮度及不透明度而廣泛應用於多種產品中。TiO2 色素廣泛用於油漆及其他塗料、塑膠及紙張，以及許多其他應用領域。此外，由於其能有效且高效地覆蓋或掩蓋其他材料，相較於其他白色顏料及填充劑，TiO2 色素是日常消費應用中的關鍵零組件。目前，我們認為 TiO2 色素沒有有效的替代品，因為沒有其他白色顏料具有與其相當的不透明度及亮度，或能以更低成本被整合使用。
我們在法國 Thann 的製造廠生產超細 TiO2。我們以 CristalActiv® 商標行銷超細 TiO2 產品。超細 TiO2 因每個 TiO2 分子相對較高的表面積而具有高度催化特性。超細 TiO2 產品的主要用途在於用於固定、移動及船舶應用的 NOx 排放控制產品中。

paragraphs: 您應仔細審閱下列所列之風險因素，以及本 Form 10-K 其他部分所載之資訊，包括我們之合併財務報表及其相關附註。本 Form 10-K 包含前瞻性陳述，這些陳述涉及風險與不確定性。任何下列風險都可能對我們之業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。此外，尚有其他風險與不確定性，目前我們尚未知悉，或目前認為不重要，但這些風險與不確定性也可能對我們之業務、財務狀況及營運成果造成重大且不利的影響。下列風險因素並非按重要性順序排列，也不應視為影響我們之業務、財務狀況及營運成果之所有潛在風險之完整清單。
市場狀況以及全球與區域經濟衰退，這些狀況會對我們終端產品之需求造成不利影響，可能會對我們之營運成果及我們銷售產品之價格造成不利影響，進而對我們之財務結果產生負面影響。

我們之營業收入與營運成果嚴重依賴二氧化鈦產品與鋯產品之銷售。這些產品之需求歷來與全球、區域與地方之 GDP 及自由支配支出相關聯，而這些因素可能因區域與全球事件或經濟與市場狀況而受到負面影響。這些事件可能導致我們產品之需求減少，市場價格下跌，進而對我們之營運成果與財務狀況產生不利影響。我們產品與原材料之大部分為商品，會隨著市場供需基礎之變化而重新定價，我們近期經歷二氧化鈦商品週期之低迷趨勢。因此，產品毛利率與營運成果會隨著商業週期之變化而有所波動。

我們二氧化鈦產品之大部分需求來自油漆與塑膠製造商。鋯產品之大部分需求來自建設及其他工業終端市場。我們之客戶可能因經濟狀況、消費者需求變化或原材料與能源成本增加，而對其終端產品之需求產生顯著波動。此外，就鋯市場而言，我們認為中國目前約佔全球鋯需求之 50%。然而，目前中國國內陶瓷終端市場之需求有所減弱，同時中國國內鋯砂生產量增加，部分歸因於中國持續著重於開採富含稀土礦物之礦物，這增加了全球鋯供應。中國若出現長期經濟衰退，可能會導致中國鋯與二氧化鈦需求減少，同時中國國內鋯生產商可能以低價出口鋯，這可能會對我們之業務與財務結果產生重大不利影響。
我們產品之價格，特別是二氧化鈦、鋯與生鐵，過去已出現波動，未來也可能出現波動。我們產品之價格下跌將對我們之財務狀況與營運成果產生負面影響。
歷來，二氧化鈦、鋯與生鐵之全球市場皆為波動，這些市場未來可能仍會波動。二氧化鈦、鋯與生鐵之價格可能因供應之相對微小變化而波動，
